title: Design Your Dream - Be Your Own Entrepreneur Hackathon for 3D Product Design
description: This individual participation hackathon is a platform for designers, engineers, students, and innovators to bring their creative 3D-printable product ideas to life. Participants will have the opportunity to design, develop, and showcase functional and industry-relevant 3D models while pushing the boundaries of innovation, usability, and design feasibility
detail: We empower businesses to reach new heights and achieve sustainable growth through tailored technology and strategic insights
bannerTitle: A event to enrich the futures of India
